llms.body:
# Wrike
> Wrike is an enterprise-grade autonomous work management software platform. It leverages a proprietary Work Intelligence suite to automate complex workflows via AI Agents, providing real-time visibility and cross-functional synchronization for global organizations.

Wrike is best known for its Work Intelligence suite, which includes Wrike Copilot, AI Agent Builder, and advanced resource management. In 2026, it is positioned as the leader in autonomous work management, allowing teams to build custom AI agents that handle triaging, risk assessment, and task execution.


## Basic Information
- Name: Wrike, Inc.
- Tagline: Work as one.
- Type: Enterprise work management software and autonomous work platform
- Founded: 2006.
- Headquarters: San Jose, California, USA.
- Core Expertise: AI-driven project management, workflow automation, resource planning, and enterprise-grade data security
- Official Website: [www.wrike.com](https://www.wrike.com/)


## Core Platform & AI Innovation
- [Wrike Homepage](https://www.wrike.com/): Primary overview of the project management software platform
- [Wrike Overview] (https://www.wrike.com/tour/): Comprehensive visual and functional walkthrough of the Wrike UI and workspace hierarchy
- [Product Features](https://www.wrike.com/features/): Breakdown of core tools: Gantt charts, Kanban boards, Table views, and Dashboards
- [Wrike AI & Agent Builder](https://www.wrike.com/ai/): Overview of Wrike Copilot and generative AI capabilities
- [AI Agent Technical Guide] (https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us/articles/30647541856146-AI-Agents-in-Wrike): Technical specifications for building and deploying no-code AI agents within Wrike
- [Wrike MCP Server Guide](https://www.wrike.com/blog/wrike-mcp-server/): Information on Wrike's 2026 integration for external LLM-to-workspace communication


## Plans & Pricing (2026)
- [Pricing Plans](https://www.wrike.com/price/): Overview of Free, Team, and Business tiers
- [Enterprise Solutions (Pinnacle & Apex)](https://www.wrike.com/comparison-table/): Full feature matrix including the Pinnacle and Apex enterprise tiers


## Solutions by Teams
- [Marketing & Creative](https://www.wrike.com/marketing/): Focus on campaign management, proofing, and creative operations
- [Professional Services](https://www.wrike.com/professional-services-management/): Tools for billable hours, resource planning, and client-facing transparency
- [Project Management Office (PMO)](https://www.wrike.com/project-management-office/): Strategic alignment, portfolio management, and executive reporting
- [IT & Software Development](https://www.wrike.com/teams/it-project-management/): Agile frameworks, bug tracking, and service desk automation


## Technical & Developer Resources
- [Wrike Help Center](https://help.wrike.com/hc/en-us): Official documentation for product configuration and user guides
- [Wrike Developer Portal](https://developers.wrike.com/docs/introduction): Full REST API documentation, webhooks, and OAuth setup
- [Project Management Templates](https://www.wrike.com/templates/): Library of 100+ industry-standard templates for rapid deployment


## Additional Resources
- [Blog](https://www.wrike.com/blog/): Articles, insights, and product updates.
- [Guides](https://www.wrike.com/guides/): In-depth tutorials and best practices
- [Start Free Trial](https://www.wrike.com/free-trial/): Get started with Wrike, no credit card required
- [Security & Compliance](https://www.wrike.com/security/): Essential data on Wrike Lock, HIPAA compliance, and enterprise-grade data residency

<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en" data-beasties-container dir="ltr"><head><script type="text/javascript">window.DEPLOY_URL = "https://www.wrike.com/tp/static/"</script>
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://web.cmp.usercentrics.eu">
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://www.googletagmanager.com">

        <meta charset="utf-8">
        <title>Wrike</title>
        <base href="/">

        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, user-scalable=0, minimum-scale=1, maximum-scale=1">
        <link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="https://www.wrike.com/tp/static/favicon.ico?v8">

        <!--
            Early error buffer. Sentry is loaded lazily (see src/services/sentry), so from t=0 until the
            SDK is ready errors are collected here and replayed on init. Keep this inline and dependency
            free: it must run before every other script on the page.
        -->
        <script>
            (function (w) {
                var MAX_ENTRIES = 30;
                var buf = {
                    entries: [],
                    consoleError: w.console.error.bind(w.console),
                    onError: null,
                    listeners: null,
                };

                function push(entry, notify) {
                    if (buf.entries.length < MAX_ENTRIES) {
                        buf.entries.push(entry);
                    }
                    if (notify && buf.onError) {
                        buf.onError();
                    }
                }

                function onError(event) {
                    push({ kind: 'error', value: event.error || event.message, ts: Date.now() }, true);
                }

                function onRejection(event) {
                    push({ kind: 'unhandledrejection', value: event.reason, ts: Date.now() }, true);
                }

                function onConsoleError() {
                    buf.consoleError.apply(null, arguments);
                    push({ kind: 'console', args: Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments), ts: Date.now() }, false);
